name: Metropolis Healthcare Ltd
about: Metropolis Healthcare Limited is one of the leading Indian diagnostics companies. The Company owns a chain of diagnostic centres across India, South Asia, Africa and the Middle East.
keyPoints: Leading Diagnostics company[1] Metropolis Healthcare Ltd is the second largest Diagnostic company in India and the largest player in Western and Southern India.
cons: Stock is trading at 7.13 times its book value
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -1.04%
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 10.5% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 12.5% over last 3 years.
